notes.title: Fix: Daily word counter update & Steam achievements still pending
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

• Fixed the issue reported by a player: the daily word counter in the "Word‑of‑the‑Day Found" leaderboard, which was stuck at 34 even after additional words were found, now updates correctly.
• Regarding the Steam achievements (e.g. “Owl of the Night”, “5 days in a row”), they are still not triggering for certain players — we're investigating and plan to fix this in a future update.

Thanks for your precise feedback! Keep sending it in the “Bugs & Feedback” thread — every report helps us make Motamo better.

Have fun playing and discovering new words!

notes.title: Motamo – A relaxing French word game
notes.content: [h2]Discover Motamo![/h2][p][/p][p]Motamo is a cozy and educational [b]French word game[/b] that helps you enrich your vocabulary while having fun.  [/p][p]✨ Features:[/p][p] - Integrated dictionary to learn as you play   [/p][p] - Relaxing and fun puzzle design [/p][p] - Playable on [b]Steam Deck [/b]with touch controls[/p][p]  📝 If you enjoy Motamo, please consider leaving us [b]review on Steam[/b][/p][p] and sharing the game with friends. [/p][p] Every little feedback helps the game grow!    [/p][p][/p][p]🎥 Watch the trailer: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/_xxOncRltLQ"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Fix: Dictionary Paging & Typo Corrections
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]• Fixed a typo in the dictionary title when opening it from the magnifying glass—the ‘n’ was missing in “dictionary.”  [/p][p]• Added paging support in the dictionary display so that when choosing entries with two or more letters, you can browse beyond the first page.[/p][p]Thank you for your detailed feedback—it helps us improve Motamo every day! Keep your bug reports and suggestions coming in the “Bugs & Feedback” discussion.[/p][p]Happy word‑forming and see you in-game![/p]

notes.title: Fix: Leaderboard Access, Word‑of‑the‑Day Reset
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]• Fixed an issue that prevented the leaderboard from loading properly at startup or after a game.  [/p][p]• Resolved the bug where the Word‑of‑the‑Day didn’t reset upon relaunch.  [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your feedback—keep sending your reports and ideas in the “Bugs & Feedback” discussion thread![/p][p]Have fun and see you in-game![/p]

notes.title: Fix: Leaderboards and Steam Deck readability
notes.content:
• Fixed an issue where leaderboards were not displaying correctly.  
• Added an option to increase font size for better readability on the Steam Deck.
